reason: I'm building next year's budget right now and this isn't in it. A metered tool from a startup with no customers loses to a headcount line every time. At most I'd let my engineers poke at the free Developer tier. That isn't buying.
objection: Per-action pricing is hard to budget. If agent traffic takes off, my bill takes off with it, and I can't walk into a budget review with 'it depends how much the bots trade.' On top of that, it's a pre-SOC 2 vendor sitting inline on order flow, and my vendor risk team will stall it anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A flat annual price with a hard cap I can put on one budget line, somewhere around $10,000 a year, with no overage surprises.
